AndroMeld brings app-by-app Android mirroring to Mac, with a Continuity-style experience across Android and macOS. Instead of mirroring the entire phone in one fixed window, it can open multiple Android apps at the same time, each in its own resizable Mac window. You can launch Android apps from Spotlight, see them in the Dock, type with the Mac keyboard, navigate with trackpad gestures, add app shortcuts to the desktop, and continue an app that is already open on your phone. results.title: Using Handoff from Chrome on Mac: Real Limits and Better Continuity Alternatives
results.content:
Chrome, which for years had a bad reputation on Macs due to its high resource consumption, has improved significantly and now runs smoothly and stably. This is especially useful if you need to sync tabs, bookmarks, and extensions between Mac, Android, and other systems.

To transfer websites, passwords, and bookmarks from your mobile to your Mac, simply install Chrome on both and use your Google account. This offers a similar experience to Safari's continuity, though without the same integration or instant access, but sufficient for most users.

## Beyond calls and files: AirDroid as a powerful companion [...] For Sync photos and videos between Mac and Android, it is recommended to use Google Photos, which uploads your entire mobile gallery and makes it available on any device with web access. For very large files or if you need a fast transfer, using a cable and manufacturer-specific software (such as HiSuite on Huawei phones) is the fastest option.

## Cloud Storage: iCloud vs. Google Drive on Mac and Android

Cloud storage is essential for continuity and productivity across devices.If you only use Apple products, iCloud is the most convenient option, but on Android, its features are limited. Google Drive works perfectly on Android and Mac, although its desktop app on macOS may be slower, while web access is faster. [...] Open System Preferences on your Mac.
 Enter the General section.
 Uncheck the option to 'Allow Handoff between this Mac and your iCloud devices'.

If after disabling it you still experience unwanted synchronizations, it is recommended Review iCloud settings and keep systems up to dateThis will prevent potential issues caused by outdated versions or residual configurations.

## Handoff alternatives for Mac and Android users, or those using Chrome

Many people use a Mac but prefer an Android phone, or simply don't want to rely on Safari. In these cases, The experience of continuity between devices changes significantly and forces us to look for alternatives..
